speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: Do you like to help children out who are less fortunate?

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: Yes I do

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: There is a child right now 8000 miles away from you who is living daily with violence and no food. But we can help her.

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: How do we help her?

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: We take money that we would spend for a piece of candy or a cup of coffee and put aside for her. Just one time will make a difference for her.

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: That sounds like a great idea! Let's do it!

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: Ok. It makes me mad that so many children around the world are facing such challenges while we sit in our comfortable home with every need met. How about you?

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: Yes, it is very disheartening. I hope that more people see the need to help others like we see the need.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: Would you like to know the charity I am talking about?

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: Yes. Please tell me more about the charity.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: It has been around for over fifty years. It is called Save The Children. They take our money and help with safety, health, and shelter for children who need it desperately.

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: I like the fact that they have history. Do you think 100% of our donations will go to the children?

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: They keep 1% for overhead but the rest goes right to the children to better the lives of them and their family.

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: That sounds fair. Do we know what geographic area we will be donating to?

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: Yes. It is the mountainous region of Uganda.

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: That is amazing! How can we get more people involved?

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: We make a donation then we tell how good it made us feel and who we helped like Lina, the girl I was talking about.

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: Ok. I would definitely like to donate!

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: How much would you like to donate from $0 to your payment of $2?

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: I would like to donate $2

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: Ok. $2 it is. Thank you.

speaker: A104RROXFLSTR6
text: Absolutely! It is for a good cause!
